name: Exile on Crystal Isle
source:
You've found yourself on the shore of a mysterious island with strange creatures. Will you be able to escape this island and navigate these creatures customs? Will you be able free their recent prisoner? Or will you become victim to the surreal existential horror of the machine.

[From [url=https://sevencents.itch.io/exileoncrystalisle]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处一个神秘岛屿的岸边，岛上有奇怪的生物。你能逃离这座岛屿并驾驭这些生物的习俗吗？你能解救他们最近的囚犯吗？或者你会成为机器超现实存在恐怖的受害者。

[来自[url=https://sevencents.itch.io/exileoncrystalisle]itch.io[/url]]
